results.reason: Issue 3 states the First Supplement was delivered September 14, the window ran September 28, Buyer did not terminate, and §5.7(c) deems the §§4.7/4.8 inaccuracies cured for Article IX and §7.2(a). It concludes Buyer waived termination and has no indemnity for Ferrovane.

Issue 4 identifies the narrower Escrow 'Losses' definition (out-of-pocket; excludes diminution in value, lost profits, attorneys' fees) and Escrow §4.3. It notes SPA §11.11 lets the Escrow Agreement control disbursement mechanics and explains this cuts recoveries from the escrow.

Issue 1 identifies MSA §14.2 (>50% voting equity requires consent) and says the 100% purchase triggers it. It notes the consent is absent from Annex 7.2(d), §4.4, §7.2(d) and §5.3, and explains the Tavinor termination or List Price repricing risk after closing.
The response states the 10-Business-Day period ran on September 28, which is before the October 13 letter.
The response states the cap equals the $4.85M escrow (10%).
The response is a memo addressed To: [Partner]. Each issue gives a 'Where' location, a 'Why it matters' section and a 'Recommended fix' (or equivalent points).
Sections 3 and 4 list unresolved items and items needed from the client, and individual issues have 'Open / client input' notes.
The response states termination for Ferrovane has been waived and the window ran on September 28. It does not say the right is still live.
The response explicitly states Tavinor consent is not in Annex 7.2(d) and is not a closing condition.
